hero.title: Authentic Vietnamese Coffee Crafted to Inspire
hero.subtitle: Discover the richness of bold Buôn Ma Thuột Robusta and fragrant Cầu Đất Arabica, carefully wood-roasted by master roasters.

story.title: Born From Passion For Every Slow Drip
story.desc1: A Hiền Coffee was founded with the aspiration to preserve and elevate traditional Vietnamese coffee culture. We believe each gentle drip of the Phin filter is a mindful pause that connects people with their soul.
story.desc2: From volcanic basalt highland soil, ripe coffee cherries are handpicked and roasted at precise golden temperatures to retain natural essential oils and a lingering sweet finish.

values.title: Mastery In Every Stage
values.item1Desc: Harvested selectively at peak ripeness from Cầu Đất & Buôn Ma Thuột farms.
values.item2Desc: Traditional small-batch roasting without chemical additives or artificial flavors.
values.item3Desc: Preserving the timeless Phin drip method enhanced with modern specialty standards.
values.item4Desc: A tranquil haven to pause, listen to rhythmic coffee drops, and escape the rush.

experience.title: Awaken All Your Senses
experience.subtitle: At A Hiền Coffee, you don't merely enjoy a drink — you immerse in an evocative Vietnamese coffee ritual.
experience.step1Desc: Discover notes of dark chocolate, ripe stone berries, and toasted hazelnut.
experience.step2Desc: Watch dense drops slowly filter through the traditional handcrafted Phin.
experience.step3Desc: Experience a velvety bittersweet warmth evolving into a resonant sweet aftertaste.

featured.title: Heritage Robusta Phin
featured.desc: A legendary blend of high-altitude Robusta and creamy condensed milk, delivering the quintessential Saigon coffee experience.

menu.title: The A Hiền Flavor Collection
menu.subtitle: From rustic Phin classics to refreshing tropical cold brew signatures.

gallery.title: Peaceful Corners At A Hiền
gallery.subtitle: Warm rustic wood meets refined modern aesthetics for an intimate retreat.
